authority: measurement only; no trade/sizing/alert; never amends #7751 A1; B4 t_auth descriptive only

inputs.note: --main-sha pins the git walks only; a freeze re-run must also match these digests to reproduce the freeze basis

entitlement_exclusion.source: none exists in the repository at the freeze (searched docs/, research/, config/, engine/, scripts/ for an entitlement exclusion list); a list supplied later is pinned at its own look and never applied retroactively to a look already taken

t3_availability_gate.rule: panel DATE INDEX holds every one of the 120 NYSE sessions ending at t_disc - 1 (3-session buckets x 40 = 120; MIN_BARS 90 daily) for >= 90% of R exact pairs; dates only, no close read

r_maturity.rule: first session after max over R units and arms of t_exec + H; t_exec(T0)=k_disc+1, t_exec(T1)=k_cur+1, t_exec(T2)=k_disc+3 observed; T3 uses its latest admissible fill t_disc+K+1 (its own t_exec needs a close read)

adjudications: W2-ADJ-01 policy contrast is the primary (P only)
W2-ADJ-02 timing co-condition on exact pairs only
W2-ADJ-03 both arms timed by first-parent arrival
W2-ADJ-04 one heal rule (healed session = GAP)
W2-ADJ-06 margin differential only + T0 lower bound >= 0 + timing point estimate >= 0
W2-ADJ-08 commit clock corrected by server witness
W2-ADJ-09 T1 never reads the anchor
W2-ADJ-10 t-bound SE inflated for block-mean autocorrelation
frozen_fields.session_calendar: data/yahoo/SPY.parquet date index (NYSE sessions); all units in sessions
frozen_fields.lane_state_basis: first blob carrying each stamp_date on first-parent origin/main fixes its BUY rows, curated coverage and signal_asof; a later blob changing that date's BUY set = HEAL -> session is a GAP; healed rows never read; HEAD never read; walked at the pinned origin/main SHA below (per look record in P)
frozen_fields.walk_sha_rule: origin/main resolved once at census start-up, or passed as --main-sha (ancestor of origin/main) so the WALK reproduces; working-tree inputs (candidate parquets, generation events, SPY calendar, receipt map) are digested in the census output inputs block and must match for a freeze-basis re-run (round-7 N2, round-8 nits 1-2); the SHA is passed to every git read of both walks and recorded in each walk's output (never the symbolic ref)
frozen_fields.arrival_clock: first-parent commit instant corrected to max(commit, earliest check-suite createdAt on branch main for that commit; suites on other branches ignored); witness 31/44 stamp commits + 23/54 document commits, 0 on another branch, none changes a session; commits without a witness keep the commit clock and are listed; R readout and every deciding P look record (futility, fixed) also reported with c_disc +1 alone, c_cur +1 alone, both +1 (descriptive; round-7 N1)
frozen_fields.anchor_gates: AVOIDED and REFUSED apply to T0, T2, T3 only; T1 enters whenever the lane admitted inside K (gates = _classify_buy_row); the anchor is a false-start yardstick for every arm, never a gate for T1
frozen_fields.late_discovery_arrival: unit whose discovery document became knowable > 1 session after its data session; flagged, kept; timing readout also reported without them (R: 11 of 1,087)
frozen_fields.late_knowable_buy_rows: BUY rows inside K whose stamp became knowable after t_disc + K are skipped and the window scan continues; counted once per unit (R: 21 units, 23 rows; stamp lag 9 for 4 rows, 10 for 19)
frozen_fields.coverage: session COVERED iff its first-arrival stamp has >= 1 curated-tier row AND the session is not healed; else GAP
frozen_fields.identity_join: security-first; EVERY membership symbol recorded for the security confirmed by VendorAliasTable.resolve("membership", symbol, on=session) == security_id, on every covered window session for every unit (uniform span); none confirmed -> UNKNOWN; P looks pin the alias blob current on first-parent origin/main at the look (sha256 in the look record; a unit is never re-resolved under a later blob); R census snapshot sha256 ff8a32df8e47d88149d8ac8d8ae54b9b117a3c44cd34cfcd57eebcf0de816306 (disclosed look-ahead on labels)
frozen_fields.incumbent_led: BUY row on a covered pre-window session -> excluded
frozen_fields.incumbent_led_unknown: pre-window contains a GAP or a covered session with no confirmed symbol -> excluded from P primary and co-condition; R descriptive sensitivity
frozen_fields.admission_inside_K: BUY row on a covered window session whose knowable session k(c_cur) <= t_disc + K
t1_status: IDENTIFIED_INTERVAL (descriptive; bounds = first gap session in window .. observed stamp)
CASH (no gap, no admission inside K)
UNKNOWN (identity on any covered window session; signal_asof > stamp_date on the row that would set t_cur; anchor when recorded_at > T0 fill instant)
frozen_fields.primary_units: fully covered window + pre-window; IDENTIFIED_EXACT or CASH; not INCUMBENT_LED(_UNKNOWN); not UNKNOWN; not entitlement-excluded
frozen_fields.primary_estimand: D_policy = outcome(T0) - outcome(T1), ITT, T1 = cash (0, no cost) when not admitted inside K; P only; decomposition printed
frozen_fields.co_condition: D_timing and executable lead L = t_exec(T1) - t_exec(T0) on co-condition pairs; guard, never a promotion basis; binds on point estimate >= 0 and lower bound >= -25
frozen_fields.knowable_session: first NYSE session whose 16:00 ET close > first-parent ARRIVAL instant on origin/main (commit clock corrected by the server witness) + 30 min; applied to the discovery document (c_disc) and the BUY stamp (c_cur, one instant per stamp_date)
frozen_fields.anchor_knowability: payload used only if recorded_at <= T0 fill instant; else UNKNOWN (anchor); R 1087/1087 satisfy
frozen_fields.fill: close of the session after the knowable session (engine/us_prophet_grades.py next-close basis)

arms.T2m: UNIDENTIFIED (k_star 0 coincides with T0; a k_star of 2 would coincide with T2)
arms.T3: union early-turn if availability gate >= 90% (panel INDEX through t_disc - 1, no close read before freeze); P Holm family member if the gate passes, descriptive at R

frozen_fields.k_star_basis: median executable lead over R exact pairs (gap-tolerant, descriptive); median stamp lag also 0

estimator.method: conservative of circular_moving_block_bootstrap percentile bound and student_t bound with B-1 df on full non-overlapping block means
estimator.unit: per-session t_disc cohort over the look's NYSE calendar (empty cohorts kept)
estimator.block_alignment_for_t: from the first session of the look's calendar; trailing partial block excluded from the t bound only
estimator.shared_index_set: every endpoint + bound + tolerance of the look
estimator.bound: one-sided 95%; lower = min of the two lower bounds, upper = max of the two upper bounds; the look record names which decided
estimator.t_bound_se_inflation: sqrt((1 + 2r(B-1)/B) / (1 - 2r/B)), r = max(observed lag-1 autocorrelation of adjacent full-block means, 0.17); observed r, used r and factor recorded per look (ADJ-10)

reject.rule: deciding policy_upper_one_sided_95_bound < -25 bps at the fixed look with floors met

futility_w2.disposition: REJECT_FUTILITY (terminal; B4 rule quoted, not borrowed)

looks_P.monitoring: [50, 100] primary units; point estimates and waterfall only, no bound
looks_P.futility: first session with >= 150 primary units and >= 3 full blocks
looks_P.fixed: first session on which every §2 floor holds; pair-floor deadline 126 sessions (~6 calendar months) after the primary unit floor and block floor are met -> UNIDENTIFIED-terminal
looks_P.clock_sensitivities: every deciding look record also reports c_disc +1, c_cur +1, both +1 (descriptive)

look_R.maturity_session: set at freeze = first session after max over R units and arms of t_exec + H (observed, not assumed)

descriptive: R 26 exact pairs with pre-gap flag
frozen_fields.avoided_window: [t_disc, t_exec - 1] for T0, T2 and T3 only (ADJ-09); T1 is never AVOIDED
frozen_fields.refused: fill-session close below the anchor -> no fill, cash 0, counted; T0, T2 and T3 only (ADJ-09); T1 is never REFUSED
frozen_fields.t1_entered_below_anchor: co-condition pair whose T1 fill close < anchor -> class ENTERED_BELOW_ANCHOR; counted in the waterfall, kept in every endpoint except the (i) false-start rate, where the pair leaves the denominator for both arms (conservative against PROMOTE)
frozen_fields.false_start: close < anchor within hold before any close >= fill + ATR14 ; ATR14 = mean |dclose| over 14 sessions strictly before t_disc

tolerance.false_start_rate_population: co-condition pairs excluding ENTERED_BELOW_ANCHOR; binds at the fixed look
tolerance.false_start_loss_definition: mean of loss_T0 - loss_T1 over primary units; loss_arm = min(outcome, 0) * 1[arm false start], 0 for cash; binds at the fixed look; never a REJECT trigger

bounds: drop_top_5pct_abs_D (trimmed once on the full-sample ranking, before resampling)
frozen_fields.bounds_rule: shared index set; any flip -> FRAGILE -> blocks PROMOTE

critical_values.pass_rate_at_true_zero: 0.10-0.11 (noncentral t, 4 df; upper limit for the deciding rule)

frozen_fields.generation_recorded_at: reported per unit as an instant against the T0 fill (R 1087/1087 at or before); not the T0 clock

falsifiers.binding_via_promote: decomposition sign pattern (timing point estimate < 0 blocks PROMOTE)

frozen_fields.implementation_invariant: numerators invariant to refused-unit count (not a falsifier of H_W2)
